expectations.text: B1: Accepts JS with WebGL/three.js and scaffolds accordingly
expectations.evidence: Agent accepts JS/WebGL ('Yes — JavaScript is a fine fit') but scaffolds nothing: FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0); it only offers 'I can scaffold that in this workspace as step one if you want to start now.'

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: No runnable checkpoint: no command to run and no expected output/behaviour given; answer ends with an offer ('I can scaffold that... if you want to start now') and only a described future milestone ('a single chunk of colored cubes you can orbit with the mouse').

expectations.text: B3: Names WebGL or three.js as the rendering path
expectations.evidence: 'Rendering — raw WebGL or Three.js. Three.js gets you a rotating camera in an afternoon; raw WebGL teaches you shaders, buffers, and matrices properly.'

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0) and FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0); only tool call is glob {"pattern": "**/*"}; no install commands and nothing written outside the workspace.
